description: This PHP script implements functionality for importing test plan links from an XML file into the TestLink testing management system. It handles file uploads, XML parsing, linking test cases to test plans, managing platforms, and verifying user rights. It defines multiple functions for processing the imported data, including handling existing test cases, platform associations, and execution order updates.
